ideas.pitch: A clinical decision-support prototype that matches acute medical scans with historical patient twins to aid emergency diagnostics.
ideas.title: CaseTwin AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the winning pattern of exceptional polish and clinical relevance seen in top health-tech hackathon projects, directly appealing to judges looking for understandable coding and high-impact innovation.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that audits algorithmic decision-making pipelines for demographic and procedural bias.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining multiple autonomous agents to cross-examine complex payloads, fulfilling the 'Innovative Idea' and 'Better Presentation' criteria.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered risk assessment model mapping local environmental data and historical weather indicators to predict hazard zones.
